mobbin:63dda702-ffb9-4b29-a69e-a58be8bf9.summary: Creator opens their management home, switches account via the sidebar identity menu, and lands on a Member discovery home with a much smaller sidebar.
steal: Step 0–1: Current role is always visible in the sidebar footer (“Alex” / “Creator”); opening the ⋮ menu lists alternate identities with a checkmark on the active one.

Step 0 vs 2: Creator sidebar exposes management modules (My page, Library, Audience, Insights, Payouts, Moderation Hub, Promotions, Community, Notifications, Settings) plus a persistent Create control; Member sidebar collapses to Home, Explore, Community, Notifications, Settings—no Create.
Step 0: Sparse Overview KPI (“Membership: 4 total”) with “Go to Insights” click-through and a Latest activity strip (comments / likes / impressions).
Step 2: Member home replaces management widgets with search, topic chips, and discovery carousels—same product shell, different job.
avoid: Step 0: Large profile/edit banner dominates the first viewport before the Overview KPI—clashes with Essentials’ “show little, but precisely” home rule.
mobbin:63dda702-ffb9-4b29-a69e-a58be8bf9.fit: Maps to role-home for admin/faculty vs learner: switcher stays on the dashboard; Creator-side Insights/Create hand off to Reports and Scenario manager / Scheduling; Member home is the lightweight learner page (own content discovery), not a second full module tile grid.
